description: Change settings of an existing HL perp copy trade. Never deletes and never pauses/resumes. Reads the current config first; omitted fields keep their current values. Configs created by SDK <= 4.12 may hold an invalid copyMode (e.g. 416/480) and oppositeCopy=true; pass copyMode, fixedAmountCostPerOrder and oppositeCopy explicitly to repair them.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

name: update_hl_copy_trade_settings
